the-crux-eqal-talking-to-ivy-sophista.speaker: Ivy Sophista
the-crux-eqal-talking-to-ivy-sophista.text: Good, you're here. I take it you received Idria's message?
If the player has not received the Armadyl communiqué:

steps.player: Message?

steps.speaker: Ivy Sophista
steps.text: It was not delivered to you? This is concerning... Still, the point is you're here. Now, are you willing to help us?

the-crux-eqal-talking-to-ivy-sophista.text: If the player read the Armadyl communiqué:

steps.player: I did, but I have a few questions...

steps.speaker: Ivy Sophista
steps.text: They will have to wait. There is only one question of importance at the moment: Are you willing to help us?

the-crux-eqal-talking-to-ivy-sophista.prompt: Start the While Guthix Sleeps quest?

steps.player: I think so...

steps.speaker: Ivy Sophista
steps.text: Good. Meet Thaerisk upstairs. There is much to discuss and Lucien's spies are everywhere.
If the player sided with Lucien during Temple of Ikov:

steps.player: But...

steps.text: If the player sided with the Guardians of Armadyl during Temple of Ikov:

steps.player: Hang on... Did you say Lucien?

steps.speaker: Ivy Sophista
steps.text: Upstairs. Now!

steps.player: I think I'll pass. This is all a bit weird for me.

steps.speaker: Ivy Sophista
steps.text: So be it. You know where to find me if you change your mind.

the-crux-eqal-talking-to-ivy-sophista-ta.speaker: Ivy Sophista
the-crux-eqal-talking-to-ivy-sophista-ta.text: What are you waiting for? Thaerisk is waiting for you upstairs.

the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-before.player: Hello there. What do you do here?

the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-before.speaker: Thaerisk
the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-before.text: Ah, I'm just keeping an eye on things and making sure nothing untoward happens.

the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-before.speaker: Thaerisk
the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-before.text: One day I hope it will be.

the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.speaker: Thaerisk
the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.text: Ah, you made it. Given recent events, that in itself is something for us to be thankful about.

the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.speaker: Thaerisk
the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.text: Unfortunately so. We've already lost several of our brethren in recent days. Lucien's agents are only growing bolder.
If the player has not received the Armadyl communiqué:

steps.player: Sorry, but I'm going to need some explanation. What's going on, and what does it have to do with Lucien?

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: You mean you do not know? Idria's message should have explained the situation.

steps.player: But I never received any message.

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: I see. In that case, I will explain what I can, but I will need to be brief.

the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.text: If the player read the Armadyl communiqué:

steps.player: Sorry, but I'm going to need a bit more of an explanation on what's going on. The message I received didn't have too many details.

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: Yes, of course. I will explain what I can, but I will need to be brief.

the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.speaker: Thaerisk
the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.text: My name is Thaerisk Cemphier and I lead a group of Guthixians called Crux Eqal. Our duty is a straightforward one: To safeguard this world from the chaos of imbalance.

the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.player: Safeguard? Doesn't that risk conflicting with the peaceful nature of being a druid?

the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.speaker: Thaerisk
the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.text: Yes, it sadly does. However, our work is a necessity. Without those of us willing to do what must be done to protect this world, peace will never be more than a fantasy.

the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.speaker: Thaerisk
the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.text: Now, while I do enjoy debating concepts such as these, we are getting sidetracked. Let's get back to the matter at hand.

the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.speaker: Thaerisk
the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.text: Precisely. We have been keeping an eye on the Mahjarrat for some time. We consider many of them to be grave threats to the safety of our world.
If the player sided with Lucien during Temple of Ikov:

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: However, truth be told, until recently, we didn't consider Lucien to be among that number. All that changed when you came along.

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: When you helped Lucien obtain the Staff of Armadyl, you set him on a path to unimaginable power. After all, Zamorak himself was once a Mahjarrat, until he used the Staff of Armadyl to attain godhood...

the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.text: If the player sided with the Guardians of Armadyl during Temple of Ikov:

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: However, truth be told, until recently, we didn't consider Lucien to be among that number. All that changed when, despite your best attempts to stop him, he managed to obtain the Staff of Armadyl.

steps.player: He has the Staff?

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: I'm afraid so, and with it, he is now on a path leading towards unimaginable power. After all, Zamorak himself was once a Mahjarrat, until he used the Staff of Armadyl to attain godhood...

the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.speaker: Thaerisk
the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.text: Hang on a moment. I hear someone approaching from downstairs. Let us wait for them to pass.
Two assassins appear.

the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.speaker: Thaerisk
the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.text: Assassins!

the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.speaker: Thaerisk
the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.text: Yes, I think so, but that was far too close. We have been dealing with the threat of Lucien's assassins for some time now, but that's the first time they've attacked us here in Taverley.

the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.player: Lucien must consider you to be quite the threat to him.

the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.text: If the player sided with Lucien during Temple of Ikov:

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: Perhaps he also sees you as a threat as well. You may have worked with him before, but I suspect that means little to someone like him.

steps.player: You think the assassins were targeting me?

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: Who could say for sure, but it may not be a coincidence that his assassins attacked so soon after your arrival.

the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.text: If the player sided with the Guardians of Armadyl during Temple of Ikov:

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: Perhaps he also sees you as a threat as well. It may not be a coincidence that his assassins attacked so soon after your arrival.

the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.speaker: Thaerisk
the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.text: Regardless, this is another reminder that time is not on our side. We must find out what Lucien is planning and stop him before it's too late.

the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.speaker: Thaerisk
the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.text: I realise that's easier said than done, but I believe we have what it takes to do so.

the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.speaker: Thaerisk
the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.text: We're still on the back foot compared to Lucien, but that is changing fast. My order has already formed an alliance with the Guardians of Armadyl and we have reached out to the Temple Knights as well.

the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.speaker: Thaerisk
the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.text: Indeed. Never would I have expected to see the followers of three different gods unite in this way, but our differences mean little compared to the threat Lucien poses.
If the player sided with Lucien during Temple of Ikov:

steps.player: And you'd like me to join this alliance as well? Even though I helped Lucien before?

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: Yes. I am aware of many of your past feats. You have regularly fought against the evils of this world. I believe there is more to you than what happened with Lucien.

the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.text: If the player sided with the Guardians of Armadyl during Temple of Ikov:

steps.player: And you'd like me to join this alliance as well?

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: Yes. You have opposed Lucien before, and you have shown that you have the skills needed to make a difference in this fight.

the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.player: I see. So what would you have me do?

the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.speaker: Thaerisk
the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.text: Our spies have been trying to track Lucien for some time, but he is proving difficult to locate. However, he has been expanding his resources at a rapid rate. We might be able to take advantage of this.

the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.speaker: Thaerisk
the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.text: He's been forming alliances with all manner of groups and individuals. Such a large collective is likely to have plenty of weak links for us to exploit.

the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.speaker: Thaerisk
the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.text: With that in mind, we'd like you to investigate a treasure hunter by the name of Movario. We believe he has been working with Lucien for some time.

the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.player: Movario? What can you tell me about him?

the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.speaker: Thaerisk
the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.text: He's magically trained, has adventured, and has spent a lot of time in various archives.

the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.player: So he's a bit of a history buff?

the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.speaker: Thaerisk
the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.text: Indeed. We suspect that his combined magical and historical knowledge is highly valuable to Lucien. In fact, we believe that it was Movario who first tracked down the Staff of Armadyl for him.

the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.player: Any ideas where I should start?

the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.speaker: Thaerisk
the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.text: According to our spies, Movario has hired a member of the Khazard Army called Darve to act as his bodyguard. As such, I'd recommend you begin at the Fight Arena.

options.text: Is there anything else you can tell me about Movario?

steps.player: Is there anything else you can tell me about Movario?

steps.text: If the player sided with Lucien during Temple of Ikov:

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: He first became a person of interest after you stole the Staff of Armadyl. He was regularly sighted in the area around the Temple of Ikov in the days beforehand.
If the player sided with the Guardians of Armadyl during Temple of Ikov:

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: He first became a person of interest after the Staff of Armadyl was stolen. He was regularly sighted in the area around the Temple of Ikov in the days beforehand.

steps.player: That doesn't seem like a lot to go on. How can you be sure he's involved?

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: Truth be told, we still don't have absolute confirmation that he is. However, few people have the skills needed to locate something like the Staff of Armadyl.

steps.player: I see. Anything else of note?

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: He seems to have been researching something new of late. He's been sighted in many libraries all across the world.

steps.player: What's he researching?

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: We're not sure. His focus seems to be on the God Wars and the gods themselves. Saradomin and Guthix in particular.

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: Given what happened with the Staff, our fear is that Lucien has him looking for more sources of godly power.

steps.player: That's... concerning. How did you find all of this out?

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: Most of this information actually came from a single spy of ours. She obtained it by talking to Reldo of all people.

steps.player: Reldo? A local librarian was the source of information on a master artefact hunter working with Lucien?

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: Yes, he's quite an interesting individual. Most of course know him as an accomplished scholar, but I've found that there's a lot more to him than first meets the eye...

options.text: Do we have any more information on what Lucien is up to?

steps.player: Do we have any more information on what Lucien is up to?

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: At this point, I'm afraid not. From what we can tell, he's mostly operated alone until very recently. However, since acquiring the Staff of Armadyl, he's been forming quite the alliance of individuals.

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: It is clear he's planning something. Something big. However, any attempts by our spies to locate him have resulted in violent ends at the hands of his new allies.

steps.player: Who are these new allies?

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: Right now they mostly seem to consist of various mercenaries and the like. However, given the resources he now has access to, we believe he's also allied with some larger organisations.

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: On top of that, there's also evidence to suggest he's been building an undead army somewhere in the Wilderness. There has been an increase in sightings of zombies and skeletons in the area.

steps.player: There's no shortage of necromancers, especially in the Wilderness. How can you be sure it's Lucien?

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: Nothing is confirmed and this point, but these undead seem to be specifically targeting our spies in the area.

steps.player: I see. Sounds like we need to learn more as soon as we can.

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: That is why I'm hoping that Movario will lead us to some answers.

options.text: Could you tell me more about Crux Eqal?

steps.player: Could you tell me more about Crux Eqal?

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: We are a group who believe that too many of our fellow Guthixians have allowed themselves to become spellbound by the beauty of nature. The wider world is constantly at threat, but they no longer wish to see it.

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: Our organisation is still fairly new, and many of our members are on the younger side. However, we have the backing of many senior druids such as Sanfew and Kaqemeex.

steps.player: I hope you don't mind me saying that druids are not known to be the best fighters. How are you ensuring that you're prepared to take on these threats?

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: You are not wrong, my friend. I have no doubt that every member of our order would willing fight to the last drop of blood if the situation required it, but it is not where our strength lies.

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: However, I do not see that as a bad thing. The world has no shortage of warriors and heroes, and our kingdoms have armies capable of standing against many a danger. Instead, we focus on what they often lack.

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: One example is our spy network. While still not quite as extensive as that of the Temple Knights, we have many who are experts in moving around unseen. After all, no one suspects a druid.

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: Then of course you have our Herblore skills, which are second to none. We are constantly making new advancements that let us supply our allies with brews and potions for all manner of purposes.

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: We're already putting many of these potions to the test in our fight against Lucien.

steps.player: I'd better get going.

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: Be careful out there.

the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.speaker: Thaerisk
the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.text: Welcome back, [player name]. What news do you have?

the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.speaker: Thaerisk
the-crux-eqal-talking-to-thaerisk-after-.text: Remember, we need you to investigate a treasure hunter by the name of Movario. Given that he hired a bodyguard from the Khazard Army, I'd recommend starting at the Fight Arena.

options.text: Is there anything else you can tell me about Movario?
Do we have any more information on what Lucien is up to?
Could you tell me more about Crux Eqal?

monitoring-movario-talking-to-a-spectato.speaker: Spectator
monitoring-movario-talking-to-a-spectato.text: Hey, you're the one who beat Bouncer! Amazing!

monitoring-movario-talking-to-a-spectato.player: You don't happen to know anyone called Darve, do you?

monitoring-movario-talking-to-a-spectato.speaker: Spectator
monitoring-movario-talking-to-a-spectato.text: Can't say I do. Maybe try in the bar?

monitoring-movario-talking-to-the-khazar.speaker: Khazard Barman
monitoring-movario-talking-to-the-khazar.text: Hi, what can I get you? We have a range of quality brews.

options.text: I'd like a Khali Brew please.
Do you know anyone called Darve?

steps.player: Do you know anyone called Darve?

steps.speaker: Khazard Barman
steps.text: I might do. Why do you want to know?

steps.player: I'm trying to find him.

steps.speaker: Khazard Barman
steps.text: Good for you, but that's not really got anything to do with me.

steps.player: Well what about someone called Movario?

steps.speaker: Khazard Barman
steps.text: Movario? The mage?

steps.player: So you know him?

steps.speaker: Khazard Barman
steps.text: I'm aware of him. Couldn't tell you anything about him though, even if I wanted to.

steps.player: Well do you know someone who can?

steps.speaker: Khazard Barman
steps.text: He sometimes uses the launderer just to the north of here. Maybe you should try talking to him. Now, would you like a drink?

options.text: I'd like a Khali Brew please.

monitoring-movario-talking-to-the-khazar.speaker: Khazard Launderer
monitoring-movario-talking-to-the-khazar.text: Those damn broavs! Now I'll need to start over again!

monitoring-movario-talking-to-the-khazar.speaker: Khazard Launderer
monitoring-movario-talking-to-the-khazar.text: Oh, sorry, I didn't see you come in.

monitoring-movario-talking-to-the-khazar.speaker: Khazard Launderer
monitoring-movario-talking-to-the-khazar.text: Just the usual sort of nonsense you get around here. One of the guards bought some broavs for tracking, but they keep getting distracted by my laundry and making a mess of it!

monitoring-movario-talking-to-the-khazar.player: Right... Anyway, you don't happen to know someone called Darve do you? Or maybe someone called Movario?

monitoring-movario-talking-to-the-khazar.speaker: Khazard Launderer
monitoring-movario-talking-to-the-khazar.text: Movario? Oh yes I... Well, actually, I shouldn't really divulge client details. Times are tough enough as it is without me losing customers through gossiping!

steps.player: Would 500 coins change your mind?

steps.speaker: Khazard Launderer
steps.text: Oh... well I suppose so.
If the player does not have 500 coins:

steps.player: Okay, I'll be back shortly with the money.

steps.text: If the player has 500 coins:
You give 500 coins to the launderer.

steps.player: Now, what can you tell me about Movario?

steps.speaker: Khazard Launderer
steps.text: Well he's a fairly regular customer of mine. In fact, I have some of his clothes here right now.

steps.player: So does he live somewhere nearby?

steps.speaker: Khazard Launderer
steps.text: I assume so, but I don't know where.

steps.player: Hmm... I need some way of tracking him down...
Hang on... What was it you were saying earlier about those broavs?

steps.speaker: Khazard Launderer
steps.text: Broavs? Well one of the guards bought some for tracking, but they keep getting distracted by the laundry.

steps.player: You don't think I'd be able to use one to track Movario, do you?

steps.speaker: Khazard Launderer
steps.text: I guess so, but they track using smell, so you'd need something that smells like him.

steps.player: Like his dirty laundry, perhaps?

steps.speaker: Khazard Launderer
steps.text: Oh, I see... I really shouldn't be giving out clothes belonging to customers.

steps.player: Surely you have something he won't miss.

steps.speaker: Khazard Launderer
steps.text: Well... I was thinking that one of his shirts wouldn't last the cleaning process. I suppose you can have it, but Movario can't find out!
The launderer gives you a dirty shirt.

steps.player: Thanks. So how would I go about getting myself one of those broavs?

steps.speaker: Khazard Launderer
steps.text: I think they came from the Feldip Hills. Apparently there's some hunting expert down there who knows how to catch them.

steps.player: Perfect! Thanks for all the help.
Okay, fair enough.

options.condition: If the player is wearing a ring of Charos(a)

steps.player: You can trust me.

steps.speaker: Khazard Launderer
steps.text: Oh... yes, I suppose I can.

steps.player: Great! So what can you tell me about Movario?

steps.speaker: Khazard Launderer
steps.text: Well he's a fairly regular customer of mine. In fact, I have some of his clothes here right now.

monitoring-movario-talking-to-the-khazar.player: Hello again. Could you remind me where I can get one of those broavs?

monitoring-movario-talking-to-the-khazar.speaker: Khazard Launderer
monitoring-movario-talking-to-the-khazar.text: I think they came from the Feldip Hills. Apparently there's some hunting expert down there who knows how to catch them.

monitoring-movario-talking-to-the-huntin.speaker: Hunting expert
monitoring-movario-talking-to-the-huntin.text: Whoah there, stranger, careful where you're walking. I almost clobbered you there; thought you were a larupia or something.

options.text: Do you think you could help me with broavs?

steps.player: Do you think you could help me with broavs?

steps.speaker: Hunting expert
steps.text: Ah, yes. You want one for some tracking I'm guessing? They're very useful for that sort of thing, but not easy to capture, especially not alive. Then, of course, there's the training.

steps.player: Training? How do I train them?

steps.speaker: Hunting expert
steps.text: I only know of one person who can do that. She's a very experienced hunter and could possibly do it for you, but I don't think she could train you to do it.

steps.player: Who?

steps.speaker: Hunting expert
steps.text: Me of course!

steps.player: Oh, okay. So I just bring a broav to you and you can train it?

steps.speaker: Hunting expert
steps.text: Pretty much, but first you'll need to catch one. You'll need to set up a pitfall trap, but instead of luring the broav over it, you'll just want to bait the trap with a fungus from Mort Myre.

steps.player: Mort Myre? That's quite the trip.

steps.text: If the player's inventory is full:

steps.speaker: Hunting expert
steps.text: Well luckily for you, I have one here I can spare you. You'll need to make some room for it first though.

steps.speaker: Hunting expert
steps.text: Well luckily for you, I have one here I can spare you. Take it and make yourself a trap over at the old trapping spot to the west. You'll have a broav caught in no time.
The hunter expert hands you some fungus with a decidedly unpleasant odour.

steps.player: Thanks!

options.text: What is that cool cape you're wearing?
Ahh, leave me alone you crazy killing person.

monitoring-movario-talking-to-the-huntin.speaker: Hunting expert
monitoring-movario-talking-to-the-huntin.text: Whoah there, stranger, careful where you're walking. I almost clobbered you there; thought you were a larupia or something.

options.text: Do you think you could help me with broavs?

steps.player: Do you think you could help me with broavs?

steps.speaker: Hunting expert
steps.text: Have you managed to catch one?

steps.player: Not yet.

steps.speaker: Hunting expert
steps.text: There's an old trapping spot to the west that should work perfectly. Remember, instead of luring the broav over your trap, you'll just want to bait it with a fungus from Mort Myre.

options.text: What is that cool cape you're wearing?
Ahh, leave me alone you crazy killing person.

monitoring-movario-catching-a-broav.text: You find an unconscious broav in the trap.

monitoring-movario-catching-a-broav-catc.text: You find a broav in the trap, but you release it as you already have one.

monitoring-movario-using-the-dirty-shirt.player: It's alright boy, take your time.
Slow and steady wins the race...

monitoring-movario-using-the-dirty-shirt.text: The broav continues to remain static.

monitoring-movario-using-the-dirty-shirt.player: Okay, this isn't going to work. I think I need to take this broav to a hunting expert to get it woken up.

monitoring-movario-talking-to-the-huntin.speaker: Hunting expert
monitoring-movario-talking-to-the-huntin.text: Whoah there, stranger, careful where you're walking. I almost clobbered you there; thought you were a larupia or something.

options.text: Do you think you could train this broav for me?

steps.player: Do you think you could train this broav for me?

steps.speaker: Hunting expert
steps.text: Not a problem. I'll get it woken up and then we can get started...
Some time passes, during which you contemplate some complex theological problems...

steps.speaker: Hunting expert
steps.text: There we go. All done!

steps.player: Thanks!

options.text: What is that cool cape you're wearing?
Ahh, leave me alone you crazy killing person.

forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-ivy-soph.speaker: Ivy Sophista
forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-ivy-soph.text: Hello there, friend. I hope things are going well for you. If you're in need of any help with... anything, perhaps you might want to talk to Thaerisk upstairs...

forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-thaerisk.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-thaerisk.text: Welcome back, [player name]. What news do you have?

forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-thaerisk.player: I've found a hideout near the Fight Arena that I think belongs to Movario. I've already found a few interesting things inside, but I'm going to keep searching and see what else I can uncover.

forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-thaerisk.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-thaerisk.text: Excellent work. I look forward to hearing the results.

forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-thaerisk.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-thaerisk.text: Welcome back, [player name]. What news do you have?

forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-thaerisk.player: I've found a hideout near the Fight Arena that seems to belong to Movario. I found these interesting research notes inside that I think might be of use.

forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-thaerisk.text: You show the research notes to Thaerisk who eagerly reads through them.

forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-thaerisk.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-thaerisk.text: Excellent work, [player name]. These notes are very useful, albeit rather concerning as well. I'll let you keep hold of them. You'll probably want to read them yourself, if you haven't already.

forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-thaerisk.player: Thanks. So what's our next move?

forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-thaerisk.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-thaerisk.text: While you were gone, our negotiations with the Temple Knights continued. Given their nature, they weren't entirely convinced on joining our alliance initially, but it seems we managed to convince them.

forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-thaerisk.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-thaerisk.text: As Taverley no longer seems to be safe, we've decided it best that we establish a base of operations for this new alliance at the White Knights' Castle in Falador.

forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-thaerisk.player: Sounds sensible. So are we heading over there now?

forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-thaerisk.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-thaerisk.text: I will be departing shortly, but I'd like you to head for the Temple of Ikov instead. We've lost contact with Idria and the Guardians of Armadyl.

forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-thaerisk.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-thaerisk.text: Hopefully it's no cause for concern, but given what happened here, I fear Lucien may be targeting them.

forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-thaerisk.player: Alright, I'll get over there right away.

forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-thaerisk.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-thaerisk.text: Head for the hidden entrance to the temple at McGrubor's Wood. Once you find Idria, send her to me at the White Knights' Castle and then join us there yourself. Good luck.

forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-thaerisk.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-thaerisk.text: Hello there, [player name]. I'll be departing for Falador shortly. You should head over to McGrubor's Wood as soon as you can. We need to make sure Idria and the Guardians of Armadyl are safe.

forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-thaerisk.player: Alright, I'll go there right away.

forming-a-fellowship-arriving-at-mcgrubo.text: A cutscene begins in which two mercenary axemen and a mercenary mage attack the Guardians of Armadyl and Idria.

forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-idria.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-idria.text: It's a good job you showed up when you did. Those mercenaries nearly had us done for!

forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-idria.player: Sent by Lucien, no doubt. Thaerisk suspected something like this would happen.

forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-idria.text: If the player sided with Lucien during Temple of Ikov:

steps.speaker: Idria
steps.text: So I take it you're [player name]? I'm Idria. I've heard a lot about you. Much of it good... though it remains to be seen if that's enough to rectify your actions in stealing the Staff of Armadyl from us.

steps.player: Well that's why I'm here. I intend to fix that mistake no matter what. I hope that means something.

steps.speaker: Idria
steps.text: It very much does. It's a rare trait to be able to admit a mistake and work to fix it, though truth be told, it seems likely that Lucien would have obtained the Staff no matter what.

steps.speaker: Idria
steps.text: But anyway, that's the past. We must focus on the future, and on ensuring said future is free of Lucien.

forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-idria.text: If the player sided with the Guardians of Armadyl during Temple of Ikov:

steps.speaker: Idria
steps.text: So I take it you're [player name]? I've heard a lot about you. It's a pleasure to finally meet you. I'm Idria.

steps.player: Pleased to meet you, Idria.

forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-idria.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-idria.text: If Thaerisk sent you, I'm guessing you're more up to speed on the current state of things than I am. What can you tell me?

forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-idria.player: The Temple Knights have agreed to join the alliance. They're establishing a headquarters in the White Knights' Castle for us to use. Thaerisk asked us to meet him there.

forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-idria.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-idria.text: Good. The more allies we have, the better. Now, given that Lucien is quite keen to see us dead, we shouldn't waste any more time here. I'll head to the White Knights' Castle as quick as possible.

forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-silif.speaker: Silif
forming-a-fellowship-talking-to-silif.text: Hello there. I'd love to stop and chat, but I'm afraid I have some important work to get done.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: Ah, there you are, [player name]. Idria told us what happened at McGrubor's Wood. I'm glad to see you made it here safely. Now, allow me to introduce Akrisae Kolluym of the Temple Knights.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: Glad to have you with us, [player name]. I've heard a lot about you from Sir Tiffy. It's Saradomin's will that you're doing!

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: Perhaps it would be best if we kept theology out of this for now. While I'm sure all of us here would love to debate our differing viewpoints, we need to keep our focus on Lucien.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: A very fair point. My apologies.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: Anyway, now that we're all here, I think it's time we discussed the contents of the notes that [player name] found. To put it bluntly, these notes confirm all of our worst fears.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: It seems that Lucien is indeed attempting to follow in Zamorak's footsteps and attain godhood. The Staff of Armadyl was merely the first step in his plan, for he now seeks an even greater prize.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: What could be more powerful than the Staff?

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: There is an artefact that history has long forgotten. One with a power unlike anything else ever seen in Gielinor. A power that even the gods themselves struggle to comprehend.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: This power you speak of... You refer to the power found in the Temple of the Eye?

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: Yes. The Eye of Saradomin is one name for this artefact, though it has had many others. For example, we in Crux Eqal know it as the Fist of Guthix. However, its real name is...

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: You speak like you have first-hand experience, [player name]. Surely you have not encountered this artefact?

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.player: Not exactly, but I was there when the Temple of the Eye was first uncovered. I had some sort of vision of the Stone. I've somehow known its name ever since.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: A vision? Curious...

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: And this Stone... You really think it can grant Lucien godhood?

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: Movario seems to think so, and he looks to have been right about everything else involving the Stone so far.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: So what do we do?

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: We must find Lucien and stop him by any means necessary.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: I agree, but unfortunately our spies have had little luck in finding him so far.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: I suspect he's somewhere in the Wilderness. Our informants believe he has been raising an undead army there at a concerning speed. It will likely rival the zombie armies of Zemouregal before long.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.player: The Wilderness is a big place. Too big. We'll need a more accurate location before we can do anything.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: I wonder if I might have a solution to that...

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: According to Movario's notes, Lucien sent a pair of spies to keep an eye on him. If we can capture one of them, they might be able to lead us to him.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: Ah, yes. We should have everything we need here to conduct an interrogation.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: It might require quite the interrogation to make one of Lucien's dogs talk.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: That depends on how loyal they are. Most of Lucien's followers seem to be mere mercenaries so far, but he does have some true believers as well.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: That said, we've recently managed to perfect a far more potent form of the traditional truth serum. I believe it should allow us to bypass any form of interrogating.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: That's all well and good, but how are we going to capture one of these spies?

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: I reckon that is something I can help with. Silif, do you have the teleorb?

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Silif
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: I have it right here, sir.
Silif gives some sort of orb to Akrisae.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: [player name], given your experience in the field, I believe you'll be best placed for this task. Take this orb and plant it on one of Lucien's spies.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.player: What is that thing? A commorb?

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: Not quite. It's a teleorb containing a sophisticated teleport spell that's directly linked to this cell here. Once planted on the spy, we can use it to bring them right to us.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: Oh that is clever!

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.player: Alright, where can I find these spies?

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: Provided Movario's notes are accurate, they should be somewhere in Draynor Village.
Akrisae gives you the teleorb.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: If you want, I can teleport you to Draynor Village.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.prompt: Teleport to Draynor Village? You can only use this teleport once.

steps.player: Yes please.

steps.text: The player is teleported.

steps.player: No thanks.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: Very well. Let me know if you change your mind.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: Hello there, [player name]. If you need a hand with anything, you should talk to Akrisae.

options.text: Tell me a bit more about yourself, Thaerisk.

steps.player: Tell me a bit more about yourself, Thaerisk.

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: Not much to tell, really. I grew up in Taverley and spent most of my life around druids. It seemed only natural for me to join them, and ten years ago that's exactly what I did.

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: After that, I travelled around most of Gielinor and saw tragedy and heartache, triumph and beauty.

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: I came back with a feeling that many of my fellow druids were a bit too absorbed in local matters and not spending enough time looking at the larger picture.

steps.player: And that's what led to Crux Eqal?

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: Yes. It turns out I wasn't quite alone in my feelings. I found a few likeminded druids and Crux Eqal was formed.

options.text: What do you know about the Stone of Jas?

steps.player: What do you know about the Stone of Jas?

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: Far more than most I suspect, but truth be told, that's still very little.

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: To us druids, it is known as the Fist of Guthix. It is a divine creation that allows one to unlock powers beyond what even the gods possess.

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: It was misused by many during the God Wars, so when Guthix awoke, he hid it away so that none would ever be able to steal its power for themselves.

steps.player: And you don't know where it was hidden?

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: No. That is a secret that only Guthix himself now knows. I hope it stays that way.

options.text: What do you think of Akrisae?

steps.player: What do you think of Akrisae?

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: He is very capable, but he reminds me of some of the druids back home. The ones that ultimately led us to form Crux Eqal.

steps.player: How so?

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: He puts a lot of faith in his god. I don't necessarily fault that. As a loyal servant of Guthix, it would be very hypocritical of me to do so.

steps.player: But?

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: But Saradomin is long gone from this world, along with all the other gods. As their followers, we must be prepared to act without their guidance.

options.text: What do you think of Idria?

steps.player: What do you think of Idria?

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: It is hard to form an opinion on her. She is very secretive. However, I sense a great sadness in her. Many of her order have already fallen victim to Lucien. I suspect she feels personally responsible.

steps.player: Well if all goes well, they'll be avenged soon.

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: I wonder if that in itself is something she feels conflicted over. Armadyl is a god of justice, not revenge. And yet, to lose those close to you...

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: If the player has not planted the teleorb on the spy

steps.speaker: Idria
steps.text: Hello, [player name]. How are things going with that spy?

steps.player: I'm still working on it.

steps.speaker: Idria
steps.text: Well if you need anything, just talk to Akrisae.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: If the player has planted the teleorb on the spy

steps.speaker: Idria
steps.text: Hello, [player name]. How are things going with that spy?

steps.player: I've managed to plant the orb!

steps.speaker: Idria
steps.text: Excellent work! You should let Akrisae know.

options.text: Do you mind if I ask you a bit about yourself?

steps.player: Do you mind if I ask you a bit about yourself?

steps.speaker: Idria
steps.text: To be honest, I'd prefer if you didn't. In our line of work, it is sometimes better not to give too much information away, especially when dealing with a threat like Lucien.

steps.player: But do you not think it would be beneficial for us to know a bit more about each other?

steps.speaker: Idria
steps.text: If you're worried about my ability to work with you and the others, I promise you have nothing to worry about. Now, let us discuss something else.

steps.player: Fair enough.

options.text: What do you know about the Stone of Jas?

steps.player: What do you know about the Stone of Jas?

steps.speaker: Idria
steps.text: I must admit, we had always wondered if the Staff of Armadyl was truly one of a kind, or if there might in fact be other artefacts out there of a similar power.

steps.speaker: Idria
steps.text: However, until now, it was all just speculation. We'd never heard of this Stone before, so to be honest, I couldn't really tell you a thing about it.

steps.speaker: Idria
steps.text: To think that it was out there for all this time... It worries me. It makes me question what else we don't know.

options.text: What do you think of Akrisae?

steps.player: What do you think of Akrisae?

steps.speaker: Idria
steps.text: He's a Saradominist through and through.

steps.player: Is that a problem?

steps.speaker: Idria
steps.text: Not necessarily. I'd say Saradominist and Armadylean beliefs are more aligned than those of most gods.

steps.speaker: Idria
steps.text: Still, I find Saradominists can be somewhat stubborn and unwilling to compromise. That could be a problem. If this alliance is to work, we'll need to set aside our egos.

options.text: What do you think of Thaerisk?

steps.player: What do you think of Thaerisk?

steps.speaker: Idria
steps.text: I find that too many Guthixians are idealists. They prefer to imagine a perfect world rather than accept the one we currently live in.

steps.speaker: Idria
steps.text: I know all too well the danger of that mindset. Our order was once the same, and we lost the Staff of Armadyl as a result.

steps.speaker: Idria
steps.text: Thaerisk on the other hand... He seems to understand that only through action can we ensure the safety of this world. We need more people like him.

steps.player: I'd better get going.

steps.speaker: Idria
steps.text: Good luck out there.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: If the player has not used the one free teleport to Draynor Village

steps.speaker: Akrisae
steps.text: Saradomin be with you, my friend. Would you like me to teleport you to Draynor Village?

steps.prompt: Teleport to Draynor Village? You can only use this teleport once.

steps.player: No thanks.

steps.speaker: Akrisae
steps.text: Very well. Let me know if you change your mind.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: If the player has already used the one free teleport to Draynor Village

steps.speaker: Akrisae
steps.text: Saradomin be with you, my friend. You should head over to Draynor Village and see if you can get that orb planted.

options.text: Could you tell me a bit more about yourself?

steps.player: Could you tell me a bit more about yourself?

steps.speaker: Akrisae
steps.text: Well I shouldn't say too much. Protocol and all that sort of thing. The more you give away, the more your enemies can use against you.

steps.player: It would be useful to know a few details though, considering we're now working together.

steps.speaker: Akrisae
steps.text: Very true. Well, as you already know, I am a member of the Temple Knights, although I'm not actually a knight myself.

steps.player: How come?

steps.speaker: Akrisae
steps.text: Normally to have reached my level of seniority, you'd have been knighted long ago. However, I was a priest originally, and technically still am.

steps.speaker: Akrisae
steps.text: A priest cannot also hold a knighthood, and so I am the one Temple Knight in a leadership role who doesn't have one.

steps.player: That's an interesting rule.

steps.speaker: Akrisae
steps.text: Isn't it just. Our order is known for having a few oddities like that, as I'm sure you yourself are aware. I hear your own recruitment involved a loophole or two.

steps.player: That's one way of putting it.

options.text: What do you know about the Stone of Jas?

steps.player: What do you know about the Stone of Jas?

steps.speaker: Akrisae
steps.text: The Eye is what we know it as. After the recent rediscovery of the Temple of the Eye, we put a great deal of effort into learning more about it. However, we didn't actually end up finding much.

steps.speaker: Akrisae
steps.text: All we really know is that Saradomin used it to great effect in the God Wars. With it, he was able to protect this world from the evil of Zamorak.

steps.player: But it seems Saradomin wasn't the only one to use it.

steps.speaker: Akrisae
steps.text: Yes, that is quite a concerning development, but this is the first time I've heard these other names that it has been given. I wonder if there might be a misunderstanding somewhere.

steps.player: So do you not believe what Movario discovered?

steps.speaker: Akrisae
steps.text: I just think it's important to keep an open mind. With how little is known about the Eye... or Stone if you prefer, we need to be very careful of any misinformation, intentional or otherwise.

options.text: What do you think of Idria?

steps.player: What do you think of Idria?

steps.speaker: Akrisae
steps.text: It is good to be working with her. Saradomin and Armadyl are natural allies. Just as the two of them once opposed Zamorak together, we will now oppose Lucien in the same way.

steps.player: It's quite something having the followers of multiple different gods all working together like this.

steps.speaker: Akrisae
steps.text: I suppose it's the one thing we can actually give Lucien credit for. He has united us in a way that few others could manage.

options.text: What do you think of Thaerisk?

steps.player: What do you think of Thaerisk?

steps.speaker: Akrisae
steps.text: It is refreshing to see a druid that is willing to stand up and take action. However, I do worry he may not have the stomach for this type of work.

steps.player: How do you mean?

steps.speaker: Akrisae
steps.text: As a Temple Knight yourself, I have no doubt you understand that we sometimes need to make difficult choices for the good of this world.

steps.player: I'd better get going.

steps.speaker: Akrisae
steps.text: Saradomin be with you, friend.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Silif
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: Ah, hello, [player name]. It's a pleasure to be working with you. Your exploits are, of course, legendary.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Silif
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: Don't mention it.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.player: Hello there. What are you doing here?

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Shady stranger
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: Oh, nothing much. I'd just heard Draynor was a nice place to visit.
You plant the teleorb on the stranger.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.player: Hello there. What are you doing here?

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Suspicious outsider
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: That's not really any of your business, is it?
This person seems far too alert for you to be able to plant anything on them.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: Welcome back, [player name]. Any luck with that orb?

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: Saradomin seems to be smiling on our operation so far!

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: I'm sure that Guthix had just as much of a role in this as anyone else did.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: I thought we agreed to keep theology out of this? Besides, I'd say this work was exclusively [player name]'s doing.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: Yes, of course, of course. Now, I believe it's time we invite one of Lucien's friends over for a little chat!

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Shady stranger
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: What the...?

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: Success!

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: Over to you, Thaerisk.
A cutscene begins in which the player and Thaerisk look at the jail cell. Incarceration is played.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: Now, before we begin the interrogation... could I interest you in a refreshing beverage?

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: Yes, of course! We may have this man imprisoned, but we should still show some decorum!

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: whispers* Play along...

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: I have one of my druids preparing you some fine juice as we speak.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Druid
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: I have the drink you requested, sire.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: Excellent! Now, if you could give it to our friend here...

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Druid
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: As you wish...
The druid enters the jail cell.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Druid
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: A drink, sir?

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Shady stranger
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: And this is... juice?

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Druid
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: Uh... yes?
The stranger kicks the druid, knocking him out and breaking the "juice".

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Shady stranger
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: Did you really think I'd fall for that?

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: The potion!

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: Someone get a healer over here, quickly!
The cutscene ends.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.player: What are we going to do now?

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: Well, that spy ruined what truth serum we had...

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: So we don't have any more? This is a disaster! It should have been clear that old druid was going to be attacked! Why send him in there?

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: Now look...

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: We cannot afford to make these mistakes. The spy should have been restrained.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.player: Alright, you've all made your points, but we're not going to achieve anything like this. Thaerisk, can we make more of this potion?

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: We're not just using any old truth serum here, so the process is quite complex. Still, it should be doable.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: First, we'll need some enriched snapdragon. Betty in Port Sarim should be able to help with that. You'll just need to take her a regular snapdragon seed.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: Snapdragon seeds aren't the cheapest.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: Well I do have one that I suppose I could part with. Let me know if you want it. I can also teleport you to Port Sarim if you wish.

steps.player: Could I have that seed?

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: Of course.
Thaerisk gives you a snapdragon seed.

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: Now, would you like me to teleport you to Port Sarim?

steps.prompt: Teleport to Port Sarim? You can only use this teleport once.

options.text: Could you teleport me to Port Sarim?

steps.player: Could you teleport me to Port Sarim?

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: Very well.
The player is teleported.

options.text: I'll make my own way there.

steps.player: I'll make my own way there.

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: Very well.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: If the player has not received a snapdragon seed from Thaerisk

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: Hello again, [player name]. You'll need to take a snapdragon seed to Betty in Port Sarim. I have one here if needed. I can also teleport you to Port Sarim if you wish.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: If the player has already received a snapdragon seed from Thaerisk

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: Hello again, [player name]. You'll need to take a snapdragon seed to Betty in Port Sarim. I can teleport you there if you wish.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: Hello, [player name]. How are things going?

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.player: I'm working on getting us a replacement truth serum.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: Well if you need anything, just talk to Thaerisk.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Akrisae
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: I hope we can get a replacement truth serum quickly. This delay is not what we need right now.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.player: Don't worry, Thaerisk and I are working on it.

forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.speaker: Shady stranger
forming-a-fellowship-capturing-a-spy-tal.text: If you think I'm going to talk, you're kidding yourself!

forming-a-fellowship-making-a-replacemen.speaker: Betty
forming-a-fellowship-making-a-replacemen.text: Hello again. What can I do for you?

options.text: Could you help me make some enriched snapdragon?

steps.player: Could you help me make some enriched snapdragon?

steps.speaker: Betty
steps.text: Enriched snapdragon, eh? There's only one person who'd be wanting one of those. So you're working with Thaerisk now?

steps.speaker: Betty
steps.text: Actually, on second thoughts, probably best I don't ask.

steps.speaker: Betty
steps.text: I can help you make the enriched snapdragon seed, but you'll then need to grow it yourself. If that's okay with you, you'll need to bring me a regular snapdragon seed.
If the player has a snapdragon seed:

steps.player: I have one right here.

steps.text: You give Betty the snapdragon seed and she places it on her counter.
If the player does not have a snapdragon seed:

steps.speaker: Betty
steps.text: Right, you now need to enrich the seed using light from the doorway filtered through a rose-tinted lens.
If the player has a lens:

steps.player: Okay, I'll get to it.

steps.text: If the player does not have a lens:

steps.player: But I don't have a rose-tinted lens.

steps.speaker: Betty
steps.text: Well I can sell you the colouring needed, but you'll have to provide your own lantern lens.

steps.player: In that case, I'll be back soon.

options.text: Could I buy some more pink dye?

forming-a-fellowship-making-a-replacemen.speaker: Betty
forming-a-fellowship-making-a-replacemen.text: Hello again. What can I do for you?

steps.player: About that enriched snapdragon...

steps.speaker: Betty
steps.text: I've placed your snapdragon seed on the counter. You now need to enrich the seed using light from the doorway filtered through a rose-tinted lens.
If the player has a rose tinted lens:

steps.player: Okay, I'll get to it.
But I don't have a rose-tinted lens.

steps.speaker: Betty
steps.text: Well if you have your own lantern lens, then I can sell you the pink dye needed to colour it.

steps.player: How much is it?

steps.speaker: Betty
steps.text: It's 20 coins per bottle.
If the player does not have 20 coins:

steps.player: Oh, I don't have enough money with me.
Sounds good.

steps.text: Betty sells you some pink dye in exchange for 20 coins.

steps.player: Actually, I'll pass.

steps.speaker: Betty
steps.text: Fair enough.

options.text: Could I buy some more pink dye?

forming-a-fellowship-making-a-replacemen.text: You use your dye to make a rose-tinted lens.
You focus the beam of light onto the snapdragon seed.

forming-a-fellowship-making-a-replacemen.speaker: Betty
forming-a-fellowship-making-a-replacemen.text: Hello again. What can I do for you?

steps.player: About that enriched snapdragon...

steps.speaker: Betty
steps.text: The seed is all ready for you. Just pick it up from the counter. After that, you'll need a specially prepared patch to grow it.

steps.player: I see. I'll have to ask Thaerisk about that. Thanks for the help, Betty.

steps.speaker: Betty
steps.text: Don't mention it.

forming-a-fellowship-making-a-replacemen.text: You take the enriched snapdragon seed from the counter.

forming-a-fellowship-making-a-replacemen.speaker: Betty
forming-a-fellowship-making-a-replacemen.text: Hello again. What can I do for you?

steps.player: About that enriched snapdragon...

steps.speaker: Betty
steps.text: What is it?

steps.player: What do I do with it now?

steps.speaker: Betty
steps.text: Now you need to grow it, but you'll need a specially prepared patch to do so.

steps.player: I see. I'll have to ask Thaerisk about that. Thanks for the help, Betty.

steps.speaker: Betty
steps.text: Don't mention it.

forming-a-fellowship-making-a-replacemen.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-making-a-replacemen.text: Hello again, [player name]. Any luck with that snapdragon seed?

forming-a-fellowship-making-a-replacemen.player: I have it right here. What now?

forming-a-fellowship-making-a-replacemen.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-making-a-replacemen.text: We've prepared a patch to grow it in. It's on top of the western tower of the castle. Head up there and get the seed planted. After that, I think Idria has a task for you.
You plant the enriched snapdragon seed in the specially prepared herb patch.

forming-a-fellowship-making-a-replacemen.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-making-a-replacemen.text: Hello again, [player name]. Any luck with that snapdragon seed?

forming-a-fellowship-making-a-replacemen.speaker: Thaerisk
forming-a-fellowship-making-a-replacemen.text: Excellent! While we wait for it to grow, I think Idria has a task for you.

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.text: Ah, there you are, [player name]. I have a new task for you.

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.player: What is it?

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.text: Provided all goes well with this replacement truth serum, we should soon know Lucien's location. However, given he now has the Staff of Armadyl, taking him on is not going to be easy.

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.player: What are you thinking?

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.text: Thanks to our alliance, we can now bring a sizable force to bear. However, for Lucien himself, we require individuals with more specialised skills.

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.text: With that in mind, we're looking to recruit a group of heroes to form a small task force. They will be the ones to deal with Lucien.

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.player: I take it you have some people in mind?

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.text: We do. Your task is to seek out and recruit three legendary Slayer Masters: Turael, Mazchna and Duradel. Alongside them, we'd also like you to recruit a great warrior called Cyrisus.

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.player: Ah, Cyrisus! I'm glad to hear he's considered a great warrior now. Back when I first met him he needed a bit of help with that sort of thing.

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.text: Oh, so you're already acquainted? That should make things easier as we've actually found it quite hard to locate him. He always seems to be on the move.

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.text: I have heard that the elusive Moon Clan have methods for contacting people across great distances. Perhaps that might allow you to easily reach out to Cyrisus and the others.

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.speaker: Turael
forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.text: 'Ello, and what are you after then?

options.text: I need to talk to you about Lucien.

steps.player: I need to talk to you about Lucien.

steps.speaker: Turael
steps.text: Lucien, eh? Can't say that's a name I'm familiar with.

steps.player: He's a Mahjarrat who's growing in power and is trying to become a god! We're forming an alliance against him at the White Knight's Castle. We'd like you to join us.

steps.speaker: Turael
steps.text: Truth be told, friend, this is basically my retirement. Still, I must admit, years of teaching amateurs how to kill goblins has had me itching to get back to the life of adventure...

steps.speaker: Turael
steps.text: Eh, you know what... I'm in! One last job, and quite the job it is!

steps.player: That's great, Turael. I'll see you in Falador.

options.text: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.speaker: Turael
forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.text: 'Ello, and what are you after then?

options.text: I need to talk to you about Lucien.

steps.player: I need to talk to you about Lucien.

steps.speaker: Turael
steps.text: I will be joining you at the White Knights' Castle very soon. I just have a few things I need to do first.

options.text: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.speaker: Turael
forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.text: 'Ello!

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.player: How are you doing, Turael?

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.speaker: Turael
forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.text: I can honestly say that I'm very excited. It's been so long since I last did anything like this, and Lucien... Well, let's just say that this will be a fitting final adventure for me.

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.player: And then what?

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.speaker: Turael
forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.text: Well, being a Slayer Master was already a form of retirement, but I reckon it might finally be time for me to leave that behind as well.

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.speaker: Turael
forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.text: No more needing to swap tasks for anyone! Can you imagine? The hours I've had to spend keeping records up to date! It will be nice not having to worry about that anymore.

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.player: Who do you think will take over from you?

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.speaker: Turael
forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.text: Well my sister, Aya, is currently filling in for me while I'm here. Maybe she'll be open to doing that longer term. If not, my daughter, Spria, has already become a capable Slayer Master herself.

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.player: And what happens if you end up getting bored of this new retirement?

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.speaker: Turael
forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.text: Well I was thinking I might take up viticulture. Someone needs to give Bernald some competition.

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.player: Well if it takes off, I'll be sure to come and try some samples.

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.speaker: Aya
forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.text: 'Ello, and what are you after then?

options.text: Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
I'm here about blessed axes again.
So you're filling in for Turael?

steps.player: So you're filling in for Turael?

steps.speaker: Aya
steps.text: That I am. It's been quite a while since I last did this sort of thing, but my brother wants one last adventure, so here I am.

steps.player: So you've done this before?

steps.speaker: Aya
steps.text: Oh yes. In fact, I was doing it before my brother was. Back in his adventuring days, I was the one here teaching people the basics.

steps.speaker: Aya
steps.text: After Spria was born, he retired from his life of thrill- seeking. That's when he took over from me.

steps.player: Interesting... I never knew that.

steps.speaker: Aya
steps.text: He doesn't talk about his adventures much, but once you get him going, you won't be able to make him stop!

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.speaker: Mazchna
forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.text: 'Ello, and what are you after then?

options.text: I need to talk to you about Lucien.

steps.player: I need to talk to you about Lucien.

steps.speaker: Mazchna
steps.text: Who?

steps.player: The Mahjarrat.

steps.speaker: Mazchna
steps.text: Oh, him? I'm surprised that coward is still around to be honest. He was never worthy of being a Mahjarrat.

steps.player: I'd be careful of underestimating him. He's managed to claim the Staff of Armadyl and is quickly growing in power.

steps.speaker: Mazchna
steps.text: Hmm... This is concerning. What can I do to help?

steps.player: We've formed an alliance at the White Knights' Castle that we'd like you to join.

steps.speaker: Mazchna
steps.text: I would be glad to. The chance to face a Mahjarrat again is something I have desired for many centuries. I look forward to the carnage.

steps.player: Great!

options.text: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.speaker: Mazchna
forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.text: 'Ello, and what are you after then?

options.text: I need to talk to you about Lucien.

steps.player: I need to talk to you about Lucien.

steps.speaker: Mazchna
steps.text: Control your enthusiasm, friend. I will join you in Falador as soon as I am able.

options.text: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.speaker: Mazchna
forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.text: 'Ello! Think you're ready to face Lucien then?

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.player: I guess so, though I have a question for you: Why do all Slayer Masters say 'ello so much?

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.speaker: Mazchna
forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.text: Ah, it's somewhat of a tradition in our order. Perhaps there was once some reason, but it's long been lost to time.

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.player: You don't know the reason? That seems a bit odd to me.

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.speaker: Mazchna
forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.text: Well who knows what would happen if we stopped? It would probably be fine, but can you really be sure?

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.player: I guess...

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.speaker: Achtryn
forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.text: 'Ello, and what are you after then?

options.text: Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
So you're filling in for Mazchna?

steps.player: So you're filling in for Mazchna?

steps.speaker: Achtryn
steps.text: Indeed I am. It's been a while since he last asked me to step in, but it's good to get out and see the sights, to meet mortals and to generally socialise.

steps.player: So do you know Mazchna well?

steps.speaker: Achtryn
steps.text: Oh, yes, he's such a mine of information. He hears what's going on at the pub, listens to the gossip of passing adventurers, and now he's off on a great adventure himself.

steps.speaker: Achtryn
steps.text: Though, of course, you know that already. Sorry to babble on. I'm sure you have plenty of other things to be doing.

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.speaker: Duradel
forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.text: 'Ello, and what are you after then?

options.text: I need to talk to you about Lucien.

steps.player: I need to talk to you about Lucien.

steps.speaker: Duradel
steps.text: Is this regarding the Staff of Armadyl?

steps.player: Yes... but how did you know about that?

steps.speaker: Duradel
steps.text: I would love to tell you, but I'm afraid I am sworn to secrecy.

steps.player: I see... Well I'm hoping you'll be willing to join our alliance against him at the White Knights' Castle.

steps.speaker: Duradel
steps.text: Willing? Yes. However, I must first ensure that me leaving Shilo Village will not be a problem...

steps.speaker: Duradel
steps.text: It seems my years of waiting are over. I have been granted leave to join your cause. Let Lucien tremble, for he will hear my laughter as his corrupt soul burns in the Abyss.

steps.player: Okay... Thanks, Duradel.

options.text: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.speaker: Duradel
forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.text: 'Ello, and what are you after then?

options.text: I need to talk to you about Lucien.

steps.player: I need to talk to you about Lucien.

steps.speaker: Duradel
steps.text: I am ready to join you. I just need to make arrangements for while I am gone, but then I will depart for Falador.

options.text: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.speaker: Duradel
forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.text: 'Ello! It's good to finally be out of that hut. After all these years, it's started to feel like a prison.

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.player: You mean you weren't permitted to leave? Who was stopping you? Who could stop you, for that matter?

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.speaker: Duradel
forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.text: Let's just say that you don't become the greatest Slayer Master without treading on some very important toes.

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.player: Now, this is getting interesting. Do tell?

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.speaker: Duradel
forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.text: I'm afraid it is a secret that will go to my grave, friend.

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.player: Hmm... Fair enough.

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.speaker: Kuradal
forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.text: 'Ello, and what are you after then?

options.text: Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
Tell me about your skillcape, please.
So you're filling in for Duradel?

steps.player: So you're filling in for Duradel?

steps.speaker: Kuradal
steps.text: I am. The task he has been given is an important one, but this post must always be filled. Who better to fill it than his own daughter.

steps.player: Daughter? So being a Slayer Master runs in the family?

steps.speaker: Kuradal
steps.text: Of course. One cannot simply grow up with someone like my father. My childhood consisted of a lot of training. My father has always been among the best, but he wanted me to be even better.

steps.player: Sounds like a lot of hard work.

steps.speaker: Kuradal
steps.text: Yes, but we wouldn't have it any other way.

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.player: Hey Cyrisus, I need to talk to you about Lucien.

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.speaker: Cyrisus
forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.text: Ah, [player name]. Good to hear from you. Who's this Lucien you speak of?

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.player: He's a Mahjarrat who's quickly growing in power. We need to stop him. Would you be willing to join a small party tasked with doing so?

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.speaker: Cyrisus
forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.text: What other challenges are there for an adventurer? If there's help I can offer, then offer it I shall!

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.player: Great! We're gathering at the White Knights' Castle in Falador.

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.speaker: Cyrisus
forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.text: Then I shall join you there.

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.player: Thanks!
Right, that's all the heroes recruited. I should probably check in with Idria.

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.speaker: Cyrisus
forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.text: Well, this is all quite exciting. It's an illustrious group that you've invited me to join.

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.player: We're happy to have you along. You've become quite the warrior.

forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.speaker: Cyrisus
forming-a-fellowship-first-recruitment-t.text: I suppose I've not done badly. Still, without you, I'd be nothing more than a coward. Thank you, friend. I won't let you down.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.player: Hey, Idria. I've recruited those heroes. They're all quite keen to take on Lucien.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.speaker: Idria
forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.text: They are not the kind of people to let evil thrive. That is why we picked them.

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.player: So what now?

forming-a-fellowship-using-the-serum-tal.speaker: Idria
