Hazelmere conjures a barrage of crystal spikes, and launches them towards Lucien, who takes no damage from it. Cyrisus and Turael move towards Lucien, but their weapons break upon attacking him. Meanwhile, Hazelmere takes Argento's seed pod out and looks at it as it begins to wilt.

the-dark-squall-lucien-s-wrath.speaker: Hazelmere
the-dark-squall-lucien-s-wrath.text: This decision was already made and was for the best. Goodbye, my friends.

the-dark-squall-lucien-s-wrath.player: Get out of there! He's too powerful!

the-dark-squall-lucien-s-wrath.text: Lucien charges up his spell as Ghommal moves to attack Lucien. As he moves in range, Lucien launches the spell and instantly disintegrate the three heroes. The spell continues moving towards Hazelmere, who accepts his fate and is disintegrated.

the-dark-squall-lucien-s-wrath.speaker: Lucien
the-dark-squall-lucien-s-wrath.text: What wonderful devastation! Now, I have things to attend to.

the-dark-squall-lucien-s-wrath.speaker: Mazchna
the-dark-squall-lucien-s-wrath.text: We must find out where Lucien went! Turael and Duradel must be avenged!

the-dark-squall-lucien-s-wrath.speaker: Harrallak Menarous
the-dark-squall-lucien-s-wrath.text: Getting back to Falador would be wiser. Did you see the way he slaughtered us? That our weapons are useless? How many more would die? Some must survive to report this nightmare!

the-dark-squall-lucien-s-wrath.speaker: Mazchna
the-dark-squall-lucien-s-wrath.text: Such knowledge lost with their deaths... You are right. We have suffered enough for one day. We must retreat.

the-dark-squall-lucien-s-wrath.speaker: Harrallak Menarous
the-dark-squall-lucien-s-wrath.text: [player name], get back to Falador! We're teleporting out now!

the-dark-squall-lucien-s-wrath.player: Hazelmere... Cyrisus... What have I done? Lucien will pay for this!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.speaker: Idria
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.text: [player name]! Thank goodness you're back. When Mazchna reported in, we feared the worst!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.player: They're gone... All of them... He killed them, like they were nothing!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.speaker: Thaerisk
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.text: We thought we knew how powerful Lucien had become. We thought we'd prepared appropriately...

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.speaker: Akrisae
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.text: I fear no amount of preparation would have been enough. We were never going to have a hope against that level of power...

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.player: He can't be allowed to get away with this!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.speaker: Idria
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.text: But what can we do? It seems we already lack the ability to stand against Lucien, and he doesn't even have the Stone yet! With it...

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.speaker: Thaerisk
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.text: He could bring an end to this world without even trying!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.speaker: Akrisae
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.text: My friends, we cannot afford to lose hope now. The situation is dire, but one of our contacts recently reported in with information that may help us turn things around.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.speaker: Akrisae
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.text: Movario has been sighted entering the caves below Lumbridge Swamp.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.speaker: Idria
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.text: Lumbridge Swamp? There's nothing of value there, is there?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.speaker: Thaerisk
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.text: Nothing that we know of, but Movario has shown interest in the area before. He wouldn't be going back there now without good reason.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.player: You don't think the Stone is down there, do you?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.speaker: Thaerisk
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.text: If there's any chance that it is, then we must make sure he doesn't find it.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.player: Hmm... I may have an idea. I could use my Dark Squall disguise to approach Movario.
I can find out what he knows, and if the Stone is down there, I can hopefully reach it before he does.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.speaker: Idria
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.text: It's a risky plan, but I suspect it's the only one we've got.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.player: Akrisae, do we have any information on where exactly in these caves Movario is?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.speaker: Akrisae
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.text: He was last seen entering a large cavern filled with some mysterious floating lights.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group.player: I can work with that. I'll head over there right away.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-akrisae.speaker: Akrisae
into-the-chasm-talking-to-akrisae.text: Saradomin be with you, [player name]. How goes your mission?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-akrisae.speaker: Akrisae
into-the-chasm-talking-to-akrisae.text: According to our contact, he was seen entering a large cavern filled with mysterious floating lights somewhere within the Lumbridge Swamp Caves.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-akrisae.speaker: Akrisae
into-the-chasm-talking-to-akrisae.text: Don't forget to disguise yourself as the Dark Squall before you approach him. We need to convince him you're someone he can trust.

options.text: Could you tell me a bit more about yourself?
What do you know about the Stone of Jas?

steps.player: About the heroes...

steps.speaker: Akrisae
steps.text: They will always be remembered, my friend. I've already made arrangements to have statues built in their honour. Everyone will know of their bravery, and their sacrifice.

steps.player: Statues? I think they'd have liked that. Thank you, Akrisae.

options.text: What do you think of Thaerisk?
What do you think of Idria?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-thaerisk.speaker: Thaerisk
into-the-chasm-talking-to-thaerisk.text: Good to see you, [player name]. How are things going?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-thaerisk.speaker: Thaerisk
into-the-chasm-talking-to-thaerisk.text: Akrisae said he'd been seen in the Lumbridge Swamp Caves. There was mention of a large cavern filled with mysterious floating lights.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-thaerisk.speaker: Thaerisk
into-the-chasm-talking-to-thaerisk.text: Just remember, you'll need to disguise yourself as the Dark Squall. That should convince Movario that you're working with him.

options.text: Tell me a bit more about yourself, Thaerisk.
What do you know about the Stone of Jas?

steps.player: About the heroes...

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: Lucien will not be allowed to get away with his actions, my friend. We will stop him.

steps.player: So you believe in revenge?

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: Revenge? No. However, I do believe in justice. I know some druids would even challenge that, but a world without justice is a world without balance.

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: Lucien, and those like him, must be held accountable for their actions. It falls to people like us to ensure that happens. It's the only way the world will stay safe.

steps.player: I just hope we can stop him soon.

steps.speaker: Thaerisk
steps.text: We will, my friend. With people like you fighting for our cause, Lucien has no hope.

options.text: What do you think of Akrisae?
What do you think of Idria?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-idria.speaker: Idria
into-the-chasm-talking-to-idria.text: Hello there, [player name]. Any luck with Movario?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-idria.speaker: Idria
into-the-chasm-talking-to-idria.text: According to Akrisae, he was last seen somewhere in the Lumbridge Swamp Caves, in a large cavern filled with mysterious floating lights.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-idria.speaker: Idria
into-the-chasm-talking-to-idria.text: If you disguise yourself as the Dark Squall, you'll hopefully be able to convince him you're working with him.

options.text: Do you mind if I ask you a bit about yourself?
What do you know about the Stone of Jas?

steps.player: About the heroes...

steps.speaker: Idria
steps.text: They will never be forgotten, [player name].

steps.player: It just feels like they died for nothing.

steps.speaker: Idria
steps.text: I know how you feel, but the sacrifices we make... it's never for nothing. They were willing to stand against a great evil so that the world might be safe.

steps.speaker: Idria
steps.text: That's how I know that Lucien will never win. We fight for something that he will never understand, and we do so no matter the chance of success.

steps.speaker: Idria
steps.text: Because of that, our sacrifices will always have far more meaning than anything he stands for.

steps.player: Thank you, Idria. That means a lot.

options.text: What do you think of Akrisae?
What do you think of Thaerisk?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.player: Movario?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: What's it to you?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.player: Lucien has sent me to check on your progress.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Darve
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: Movario! That's...

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: Yes, Darve, I can see who it is. Let it be known, Surok, that I am not one of your minions. I will not bow down to your attempts to intimidate me.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: As for my progress, you can tell Lucien that the investigations would be greatly expedited if I weren't subject to all these interruptions!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.player: Then allow me to expedite things myself. Time is now of the essence and Lucien's patience is wearing thin.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: You would take over? Preposterous!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.player: While Lucien has asked me to oversee your investigations, I am not unreasonable. Believe it or not, I've actually read much of your detailed research myself.
You are clearly an expert in this area, and I am open to letting you continue to take the lead, provided we are able to quickly conclude our work here.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Darve
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: Looks like we don't have much choice, boss.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.player: Now, please share what you know with me.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: Hmph. Very well. Given you have read my research, and given Lucien himself sent you, I trust you know what it is I seek.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.player: I do.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: Even with all that I know, I can still scarcely even imagine it! A power beyond even the gods themselves!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.player: I am all too aware, but all this means little given you have still not found it.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: Oh, but I believe I have found it. More than that, I believe we are stood right above it.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.player: Right above it? Surely you don't mean the chasm?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: That's precisely what I mean. Perhaps now you see the issue that I face. Reaching the bottom will require a significant amount of effort.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: I attempted to recruit some goblins to find a way down, but they proved... inadequate. I fear a gantry will need building, which will not be a quick process.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.player: And what about the light creatures? Are they of no use?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: I don't think so... though I suppose they are rather unique. Perhaps I shall study their movements at some point.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Darve
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: I think Surok has an idea for using them, boss!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.player: Allow me to explain. This isn't my first time in these caves. On a previous visit, I found that a special type of lantern with a distinct blue light could attract the creatures.
Once attracted, they'd surround you and carry you to the far side.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Darve
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: You wouldn't get me in one of those things! Not on your life!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: Shut up, Darve! The adults are talking!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: Did you ever manage to get them to go downwards? To the bottom?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.player: No. I assume the lantern isn't bright enough for that.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: Hmm, intriguing! I know of a light spell which might work. If you were to use your lantern to call a creature, I could try and use my spell to send it down to the bottom of the chasm!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: However, that does then pose a problem.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.player: Yes?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: Well it would mean you'd be going down first! After all this work, do you really think I'm just going to let you get your hands all over my finds?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.player: Your finds? Is that how Lucien would describe them? What do you think he will do if I inform him of your lack of cooperation?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: Okay, fine! Given I have no choice, when you're ready to go down, just attract a light creature. Once you're in position, I'll use my light spell.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.player: Movario?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: What's it to you?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.player: Nothing, I guess.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: Then be gone, before I set Darve on you!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: Ah, so you've returned. Ready to take your trip to the bottom yet?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Darve
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: Can we hurry things up? I've got better things to do than hang around these filthy caves!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.player: Shut up, Darve!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: Well said!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.player: Remind me what I need to do.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: Just attract one of the light creatures using one of those lanterns you were talking about. When you're in position, I'll use my light spell to send you down to the bottom of the chasm.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Darve
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: I hope that Surok character doesn't come back. There's something not right about him... He makes General Khazard seem normal!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: If you don't like him, be glad you've never met Lucien.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.player: Movario?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: What's it to you?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.player: Nothing, I guess.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-in-dis.text: Then be gone, before I set Darve on you!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-after-.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-after-.text: You've returned! What news of the bottom? What's down there?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-after-.player: Oh, it's very dark down there. I can hardly see anything! It's going to take more work for me to get anywhere.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-after-.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-after-.text: Well then let me help! Tell me, how do we summon the light creatures? I made one of those blue lanterns, but they still don't seem to come!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-after-.player: I'm not sure. It worked fine for me.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-after-.speaker: Darve
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-after-.text: It's that big snake over there! I keep telling you, every time you start enticing one, it does something to them! Why don't you listen to me?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-after-.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-after-.text: It seems highly unlikely that a snake has that capability. That thing is nothing more than a bloated earth worm! Now silence, Darve!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-after-.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-after-.text: As for you, what can you tell me about the chasm?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-after-.player: Nothing much. Like I say, it's very dark. Now, I'm sorry, but I've answered your questions. You should let me get back to work.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-after-.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-after-.text: The impertinence! I'll ask these same questions until I get the answers I need! Now tell me, what's down there?

into-the-chasm-talking-to-movario-after-.player: Oh, it's very dark down there. I can hardly see anything! It's going to take more work for me to get anywhere.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-idria-after-en.text: Hello there, [player name]. Any luck with Movario?

into-the-chasm-the-balance-elemental.text: A cutscene plays. As the player sees the Stone of Jas, energy begins to coalesce in front of it, forming into the Balance Elemental.

into-the-chasm-the-balance-elemental.speaker: Balance Elemental
into-the-chasm-the-balance-elemental.text: In the name of Guthix, what rights do you have here?

into-the-chasm-the-balance-elemental.player: I don't know who you are... or what you are for that matter, but we don't have much time! The Stone is in danger!

into-the-chasm-the-balance-elemental.speaker: Balance Elemental
into-the-chasm-the-balance-elemental.text: The Stone is always in danger. That is why I stand before you, [player name].

into-the-chasm-the-balance-elemental.speaker: Balance Elemental
into-the-chasm-the-balance-elemental.text: I know everything about you, [player name]. I have seen your past, your present and your future.

into-the-chasm-the-balance-elemental.player: Then you must have seen Lucien and his power! We have to get the Stone to safety!

into-the-chasm-the-balance-elemental.speaker: Balance Elemental
into-the-chasm-the-balance-elemental.text: Your duty is noble, [player name], but so is mine: To protect the Stone until a time when, near to death, you are relieved of all duties with the gratitude and blessings of Guthix.

into-the-chasm-the-balance-elemental.speaker: Balance Elemental
into-the-chasm-the-balance-elemental.text: I am not here to help. I wish you all the best, [player name], but I am charged with a singular purpose, and I will now do my duty...
The cutscene ends, and the Balance Elemental begins to attack the player.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: A cutscene begins, showing the Stone of Jas covered by magical rocks.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Mysterious Voice
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: I still don't understand, [player name].
V approaches the Stone, and touches it.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.player: It was V who first found it, deep below the ice of Lunar Isle. A single touch granted him the power of the gods. The power of limitless creation...

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: The scene changes to the Demonic Ruins.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.player: Over the centuries, it changed hands many times. For each person who'd use it for good, another would use it to destroy...

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: The scene changes to the Lithkren Vault entrance.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Mysterious Voice
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: And the kin?

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.player: They were bound to it long ago. To use the Stone causes them unimaginable pain, and grants them immense power.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: The scene returns to the Ancient Guthix Temple, depicting Robert the Strong, Camorra, Tristan, and Aivas facing the Stone.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Robert the Strong
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: So the only way to win...
The screen fades to black as Robert begins to touch the Stone, ending the cutscene.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: The Stone! After all this time... I've finally found it!

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Darve
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: And look who's here as well! The so-called Lord Surok!

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: Yes, quite a clever ploy, [player name], but you should have known I'd work it out. Now, step aside.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.player: And let you take the Stone? I don't think so.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: We stand before the most important, the most significant, the most powerful artefact to ever be discovered in Gielinor, and it's all thanks to me!

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: With the patience of a thousand men, I have spent my life following the smallest of clues and the slightest of hints to discover only the most minute inkling of its existence!

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: So yes, you will step aside, because after all I've done to get here, I have no intention of letting you stop me now!

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.player: If Lucien gets the Stone, the world burns. I don't plan on letting that happen.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: And what makes you think Lucien will ever lay his hands on it? He may have contributed to my research funds, certainly, but in terms of actual possession, I now hold the cards.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.player: You'd be a fool to cross him. He'd wipe you from existence before you could even say a word.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: Before, yes, but now... Now the power of the Stone is in the palm of my hand. Lucien has no hope of standing against that.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.player: Except you don't have the Stone yet. You'll have to get through me first.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Darve
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: No problems! I'll easily deal with you, mate!

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: Darve, I wouldn't be too enthusiastic about tangling with our friend here. His strength is... unusual. Surely you didn't...

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: Hang on... I detect a build up of energy...
Lucien appears.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Lucien
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: Movario.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: Lord Lucien! We did not expect...

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Lucien
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: It seems you have found the Stone. Why was I not informed?

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: The discovery was made mere moments ago, my lord. Now I need time to conduct research and ensure it's safe to...

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Lucien
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: Silence! Do you not feel that, Movario? It calls to me... my birthright!

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Lucien
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: Icthlarin... Zaros... Zamorak... All of them false! Finally the Mahjarrat shall take their rightful place as the sole inheritors of Gielinor, and I will be their god!

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Lucien
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: Any who stand in my way shall be swept away like the civilisations of old. For those that are lucky, their children shall become slaves!

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.player: I wouldn't be so sure about that!

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Lucien
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: Ah, [player name], I see you have decided to interfere once again. Commendable, but meaningless. You cannot stop what is to come. Death is all that awaits you if you try.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.player: You'll never have the satisfaction of killing me, Lucien. No matter what it takes, I'll make it my mission to stop you.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Lucien
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: Such arrogance. Do you not realise who you address? I am Lord Lucien of the Mahjarrat, Master of the Thousand Curses. Look upon my works and despair!

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.player: You can bestow as many titles upon yourself as you like, but before long, no one will even remember your name. You're just another monster, craving a power you'll never have.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Lucien
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: Are you truly so misguided that you cannot see the truth before you? I hold both the Staff of Armadyl and the Stone of Jas!

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Lucien
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: Not since Zamorak himself has anyone possessed this much power! Nothing will stop me following in his footsteps!

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.player: You think Zamorak will just stand by and let that happen?

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Lucien
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: He doesn't have a choice. He no longer has any power here. His days are already done.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Lucien
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: Now, this conversation bores me. My ascension approaches, and I only have room for the strongest as my worshippers. Those too weak to slay even these lowly beasts will certainly not be wanted!

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Movario
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: Time for us to leave, Darve!
As Movario teleports himself and Darve away, Lucien teleports the Stone and summons two Tormented Demons. As Lucien teleports away, the Guardians of Armadyl and Idria teleport in to assist you.

into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.speaker: Idria
into-the-chasm-touching-the-stone-of-jas.text: We're with you, [player name]!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-akrisae-before.speaker: Akrisae
into-the-chasm-talking-to-akrisae-before.text: [player name], you must return to the temple below Lumbridge! Idria and her Guardians of Armadyl have already departed to support you!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-thaerisk-befor.speaker: Thaerisk
into-the-chasm-talking-to-thaerisk-befor.text: [player name], you must return to the temple below Lumbridge! Idria and her Guardians of Armadyl have already departed to support you!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-idria-after-ki.speaker: Idria
into-the-chasm-talking-to-idria-after-ki.text: That was astounding, [player name]! Good work!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-idria-after-ki.speaker: Idria
into-the-chasm-talking-to-idria-after-ki.text: Blessed Armadyl, that was incredible! The Stone must have augmented your strengths. I've never seen anything like it!

into-the-chasm-talking-to-idria-after-ki.speaker: Idria
into-the-chasm-talking-to-idria-after-ki.text: Now, we'd better get back to Falador. Do you want me to teleport you there?

steps.player: Yes please.

steps.text: The player is teleported.

steps.player: No thanks. I'll make my own way back.

steps.speaker: Idria
steps.text: Very well. I'll see you back there.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group-2.player: Not exactly. I'm sorry... I failed. Lucien has the Stone.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group-2.speaker: Thaerisk
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group-2.text: Then our worst fears have come to pass. The horrors that he could unleash with it...

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group-2.speaker: Idria
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group-2.text: That's something he'll never have a chance to do. Yes, this is a dark day, but I don't intend to give up, and I'm sure none of you do either.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group-2.speaker: Idria
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group-2.text: [player name], you've helped forge an alliance between the Temple Knights, Crux Eqal and the Guardians of Armadyl. Three very different groups, all fighting for the common good.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group-2.speaker: Idria
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group-2.text: We must build on that. We will strengthen our forces, and find new allies to join our cause. When Lucien dares to rear his head again, we'll be ready.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group-2.speaker: Akrisae
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group-2.text: Well said. When times are darkest, it is all the more important that we continue to look for the light. The Temple Knights stand ready.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group-2.speaker: Thaerisk
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group-2.text: As do we in Crux Eqal.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group-2.speaker: Thaerisk
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group-2.text: Rest, my friend. You have well and truly earned it. We will take things from here.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group-2.speaker: Idria
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group-2.text: Don't worry, [player name]. When the time is right, you'll be the first to know. I promise you, we will find Lucien. Together, we will stop him.

into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group-2.speaker: Thaerisk
into-the-chasm-talking-to-the-group-2.text: And the world will be safe once more.

steps.speaker: Sakirth
steps.text: Zorgoth?

steps.speaker: Sithaph
steps.text: Dead.

steps.speaker: Strisath
steps.text: Then we are free at last!

steps.speaker: Sakirth
steps.text: And a strength grows within us!

steps.speaker: Sithaph
steps.text: The Stone has been uncovered. The mortals try to claim its power.

steps.speaker: Sakirth

steps.speaker: Strisath

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-idria.player: Hey, Idria. How are things here?

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-idria.speaker: Idria
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-idria.text: We're still trying to work out what Lucien's next move is, but so far everything has been quiet.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-idria.player: What do you think he's doing?

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-idria.speaker: Idria
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-idria.text: It's hard to say. He has the Stone of Jas and the Staff of Armadyl now. That should give him everything he needs to follow in Zamorak's footsteps, but for whatever reason, he's chosen not to act yet.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-idria.player: Is there anything I can do?

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-idria.speaker: Idria
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-idria.text: Not really at this point, but we'll be sure to let you know the moment he dares try anything. In the meantime, you might want to return to that temple beneath Lumbridge.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-idria.speaker: Idria
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-idria.text: It seems the magics Lucien used down there were far more than just a single summoning spell. The area has been permanently desecrated by those horrifying demons.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-idria.speaker: Idria
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-idria.text: If you were looking for some way of keeping Lucien and his forces in check, killing a few of those demons wouldn't be a bad idea.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-idria.player: I might just do that. Thanks, Idria.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-akrisae.speaker: Akrisae
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-akrisae.text: Saradomin be with you, [player name]. We have a lot to be grateful to you for.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-akrisae.player: Thanks, but I'm not sure I feel the same way. I wasn't able to stop Lucien.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-akrisae.speaker: Akrisae
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-akrisae.text: But you came very close and you lived to tell the tale. Lucien may have gained the upper hand, but he's not safe by any means.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-akrisae.speaker: Akrisae
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-akrisae.text: He has people like you opposing him, not to mention an alliance between the Temple Knights, Crux Eqal and the Guardians of Armadyl!

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-akrisae.player: You make a good point. Let's just hope it will be enough.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-thaerisk.speaker: Thaerisk
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-thaerisk.text: Ah, [player name], it's good to see you again.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-thaerisk.player: Hello there, Thaerisk. Any word on Lucien?

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-thaerisk.speaker: Thaerisk
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-thaerisk.text: Nothing yet, but we're doing everything we can to find him. I hope he's ready for us, because once we do locate him, we're going to give him quite the bloody nose...

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-thaerisk.speaker: Thaerisk
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-thaerisk.text: ... or at least whatever passes for a nose on a Mahjarrat!

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-silif.speaker: Silif
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-silif.text: Hello there, friend. I heard what happened with Lucien and the Stone. Don't worry, he'll pay for his crimes sooner or later.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-silif.speaker: Silif
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-silif.text: Have faith, friend. Evil never prospers for long.

options.text: I lost those robes I was using as a disguise.

steps.player: I lost those robes I was using as a disguise.

steps.speaker: Silif
steps.text: Not to worry. I have them here for you.
Silif gives you some Dark Squall robes.

steps.player: Thanks!
I'd better get going.

steps.speaker: Silif
steps.text: Until next time, friend.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-surok.player: How are you enjoying your cell, Surok?

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-surok.speaker: Surok Magis
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-surok.text: You let me out of here! This isn't over...

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-surok.player: It's nice to see a little justice around here!

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-sir-tiffy.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-sir-tiffy.text: Good day, Proselyte. I heard from Akrisae what happened with that Lucien business. Be sure to keep your chin up. We'll get the old boy sooner or later.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-sir-tiffy.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-sir-tiffy.text: Don't mention it, old bean. Now, is there anything I can do for you?

options.text: Do you have any jobs for me yet?
I have news on that assassin who attacked Entrana.
Can you explain the Gaze of Saradomin to me?

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-aya.speaker: Aya
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-aya.text: 'Ello, and what are you after then?

options.text: Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
I'm here about blessed axes again.

steps.player: About Turael...

steps.speaker: Aya
steps.text: You need not share your condolences with me, adventurer. I've been prepared for this for a long time.

steps.player: You have?

steps.speaker: Aya
steps.text: My brother was a thrill-seeker his whole life. Even after he retired, I always knew something would come and pull him back in.

steps.player: And that something was me. I'm sorry...

steps.speaker: Aya
steps.text: Don't be. He died doing what he loved, and he died a hero. He wouldn't have had it any other way.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-spria.speaker: Aya
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-spria.text: 'Ello, and what are you after then?

options.text: Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.

steps.player: About Turael...

steps.speaker: Spria
steps.text: It's nothing personal, but I'd prefer not to discuss what happened with my father.

steps.player: Of course. Sorry for bringing it up.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-harrallak.speaker: Harrallak Menarous
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-harrallak.text: Welcome to my humble Guild, [player name].

steps.player: How are you, Harrallak?

steps.speaker: Harrallak Menarous
steps.text: I've lost two of my dear friends, [player name]. This old place doesn't seem to be the same since they're gone.

steps.player: I feel responsible.

steps.speaker: Harrallak Menarous
steps.text: Nonsense, my friend! They both died bravely fighting against a great evil! There is no blame on you for that.

steps.speaker: Harrallak Menarous
steps.text: Remember them for who they were and what they stood for. Mourn their loss, but never bear the burden of their death, for that is not what they would want.

steps.player: And what about vengeance?

steps.speaker: Harrallak Menarous
steps.text: Ah, now that is a topic we could debate for many moons, my friend. Still, regardless of the reason, know that when the time comes, I will fight beside you against Lucien once more.

options.text: Could you tell me more about the Guild?
Can you tell me a bit about skillcapes?
Why are you wielding a tree branch?

steps.player: Why are you wielding a tree branch?

steps.speaker: Yadech Strongarm
steps.text: Well... there's a story to that. You see, I should have an axe but-

steps.player: Sloane's axe?

steps.speaker: Yadech Strongarm
steps.text: My axe. He won it because of a squirrel.

steps.player: A squirrel?

steps.speaker: Yadech Strongarm
steps.text: He bet me that I couldn't catch the squirrel while still holding my axe, but that he could... Thing is, he tricked me! When it was his turn, he just chopped the tree down!

steps.player: I see. That doesn't explain why you have a tree branch though.

steps.speaker: Yadech Strongarm
steps.text: A barbarian warrior is bound to his axe. I cannot take up another, so I use part of the tree that Sloane cut down as my weapon... It also reminds me of him.

steps.player: He was a great warrior.

steps.speaker: Yadech Strongarm
steps.text: Yes, and a good friend. Still, he would want us to be happy that he is now with his warrior brethren. Can I help you with anything else?

options.text: May I claim my tokens please?

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-mazchna.speaker: Mazchna
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-mazchna.text: 'Ello, and what are you after then?

options.text: Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.

steps.player: About Lucien...

steps.speaker: Mazchna
steps.text: He will be made to pay, my friend, and I assure you, when the day of his reckoning comes, I will be there.

steps.player: So will I, Mazchna.

steps.speaker: Mazchna
steps.text: Then we will fight, side by side, my friend. We will fight in honour of Turael and Duradel, and we will see them avenged!

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-kuradal.speaker: Kuradal
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-kuradal.text: 'Ello, and what are you after then?

options.text: Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
Tell me about your skillcape, please.

steps.player: About Duradel...

steps.speaker: Kuradal
steps.text: Are you here with news on Lucien?

steps.player: I'm afraid not.

steps.speaker: Kuradal
steps.text: The moment you find him, you must come to me. I will ensure my father is avenged!

steps.player: He wouldn't want you to get yourself killed as well!

steps.text: If the player has not yet received Duradel's notes:

steps.speaker: Kuradal
steps.text: I will not suffer the same fate as my father. I intend to be prepared. For a start, I have been researching my father's notes to find weaknesses in Lucien's demonic thralls.

steps.player: Those sound interesting. May I see them?

steps.speaker: Kuradal
steps.text: Of course. If we expect to defeat Lucien, we must work together.
If the player's inventory is full:

steps.speaker: Kuradal
steps.text: Return to me when you have space to carry them.
Kuradal hands you an old notebook.
If the player has received Duradel's notes:

steps.speaker: Kuradal
steps.text: I will not suffer the same fate as my father. That fate is reserved for Lucien!

steps.player: I hope you're right...

steps.text: If the player has not read Duradel's notes and it is not in their possession:

steps.speaker: Kuradal
steps.text: I will not suffer the same fate as my father. I intend to be prepared. For a start, I have been researching my father's notes to find weaknesses in Lucien's demonic thralls.

steps.player: Speaking of those notes, I seem to have misplaced them. Do you happen to have another copy?

steps.speaker: Kuradal
steps.text: Luckily for you, I made many.
If the player has sufficient inventory space:
If the player has no free inventory space:

steps.speaker: Kuradal
steps.text: Return to me when you have space to carry them.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-the-oneir.speaker: Oneiromancer
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-the-oneir.text: Hello there. What do you want to talk about?

steps.player: Hi.

steps.speaker: Oneiromancer
steps.text: Hello there. I hear that Cyrisus is no longer with us.

steps.player: He died fighting for a good cause. He'll be remembered as a great hero.

steps.speaker: Oneiromancer
steps.text: I suppose the good do die young.

post-quest-dialogue-attempting-to-contac.text: You take a moment of silence in honour of your fallen friend, Cyrisus.
